page.about.title: About Mail
page.about.lead: A self-hosted project for mail infrastructure operators.
about.project.body: Mail is a free, open-source, self-hosted service for administrators who configure and monitor Postfix, Dovecot, SpamAssassin, Rspamd, Amavisd-new, Pyzor, Razor, ClamAV, OpenDKIM, Fail2ban, Policyd, and Postgrey when installed. Its product scope includes system and virtual users, domains, aliases, forwarding, transports, queue operations, spam and virus controls, TLS, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, service health, logs, delivery statistics, backups, DNS guidance, and alerts.

mcp.help.project.title: Mail tools and guidance
mcp.help.project.default:
# Mail operations

Mail domains, virtual mailboxes, aliases, forwarding rules, and the Postfix queue are global resources owned by the operator. Mail-management tools are available only to the operator token; owner and linked tokens can use the public server tools. Mail changes are audited. Queue mutations also require the runtime account to have the corresponding Postfix permission.

Useful tools include `listMailDomains`, `getMailDomainDNS`, `getMailDomainDKIM`, `listMailUsers`, `getMailQueueStats`, and `listMailQueue`. DNS guidance reports MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC values and missing record types. User and queue listings accept pages of 1 to 250 records; queue metadata can contain mail addresses.

Example requests: “List mail domains and identify missing DNS records.” “Show queue counts and inspect current entries.” “List virtual mailboxes.” Confirm before creating or deleting mail records, or holding, releasing, flushing, or deleting queued messages. Database changes do not yet synchronize into a running MTA. This project exposes no MCP resources or prompts.

privacy.additional.title: Additional privacy information
privacy.data_collection:
**We collect only what is necessary to provide our service:**

**Usage Information (with consent):**
- Pages visited and features used
- Browser type and device information
- Approximate location (country/region from IP, not precise)

**Technical Information:**
- IP address (for security and abuse prevention)
- API token identifiers (hashed, never stored in plain text)

**We do NOT collect:**
- Payment information (unless explicitly required by the service)
- Precise location data
- Data from other websites or apps
privacy.data_usage:
**Your data is used solely to:**

- **Provide the service:** Authentication, core functionality
- **Improve the experience:** Performance optimization, bug fixes, feature improvements
- **Ensure security:** Prevent abuse, detect fraud, protect the service
- **Communicate:** Service updates, security alerts, and (with consent) product news

**Your data is NEVER:**
- Sold to third parties
- Used for targeted advertising
- Shared without your explicit consent (except as required by law)
privacy.data_usage.sold:
**Your data may be used to:**

- **Provide the service:** Authentication, core functionality
- **Improve the experience:** Performance optimization, bug fixes, feature improvements
- **Ensure security:** Prevent abuse, detect fraud, protect the service
- **Communicate:** Service updates, security alerts, and (with consent) product news
- **Third-party sharing:** Your data may be shared with or sold to third parties for analytics, advertising, or other purposes as described below

**Your rights:**
- You can opt out of data sales with the CCPA opt-out on the preferences page (`/server/preferences`)
- You can delete the resources you created at any time with your owner token, and request deletion of other data through the contact details on the privacy page
- See "Your Rights" section below for details
privacy.data_security:
**How we protect your data:**

- All data is stored on our servers (not third-party cloud services unless specified)
- API tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes (never in plain text)
- Connections are encrypted with HTTPS/TLS when the site is served that way; the page says "This site is currently served without TLS" instead when the request did not arrive over TLS (as URL detection sees it, trusted reverse proxy headers included)
- Regular security audits and updates
- Access controls and audit logging for operator actions

about.description.title: About Mail
about.features.title: Features
about.features.body:
- Manage Postfix, Dovecot, and optional mail services.
- Support system and virtual users, domains, aliases, forwards, and transports.
- Inspect and operate the mail queue.
- Configure spam and virus filtering, TLS, DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.
- Monitor service health, logs, delivery and spam statistics, and alerts.
- Back up configuration and review DNS guidance.
